name: Investment Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires either a USD 300,000+ investment in Georgia or ownership of non-agricultural property exceeding that value.
requirements.fix_path: Fund the qualifying investment or property purchase.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires documented annual turnover of at least USD 50,000 in year 1, USD 100,000 in year 2, and USD 120,000 in years 3-5 to maintain the permit.

evidence_required.document: Proof of investment or non-agricultural property valued over USD 300,000
Annual turnover documentation (escalating over the 5-year permit)

sources.title: Legislative Herald of Georgia (matsne.gov.ge) -- Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 15(h)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Georgia's initial build. This is Georgia's main property/business-based investment migration route -- the commonly-cited older figure of USD 100,000 found in several tier-3/4 blog posts during this research pass appears OUTDATED; the current tier-1 (matsne.gov.ge) and tier-1-adjacent (sda.gov.ge) figure is USD 300,000, which is used here instead. work_rights 'restricted': tied to the investment/business activity itself, not open local employment. pr_after_months (60) reflects Article 15(k)'s route to unlimited residence after 5 years holding this permit with documented turnover, per ge_unlimited_residence_investment's own sourcing.
